history_identity: seed identity + vector transition word + internal lineage identity
integer_addition_rule: recoalesced histories add in N; multiplicity never boolean-collapses to 1

required_case_certificates.branch: G1 I-seed has W0 and WD distinct branches
required_case_certificates.different_axis_same_endpoint: W0 and loop variants use candidate axis d plus rho(d) axis yet all terminate at coordinate 2d

required_case_certificates.exact_endpoint_tie: two candidates with identical (A,I) under a fixed grammar have identical endpoint multiplicity and remain unresolved
required_case_certificates.immediate_reversal: W0 contains q,-q; WD contains d,-d
required_case_certificates.loop: WD contains (-d,d) zero-sum loop; WQ contains (-q,q) zero-sum loop
required_case_certificates.multiplicity_gt_1: G3 incidence unit seed has four distinct histories recoalescing at one endpoint
required_case_certificates.recoalescence: all branch histories compress by natural-integer addition at common P3 endpoint
required_case_certificates.revisit: WD/WQ/WDQ revisit declared packet states; W0 revisits Lambda coordinate 2d at P1 and P3 while packet states differ
required_case_certificates.same_axis_opposite_orientation: WD contains d and -d; W0 contains q and -q
required_case_certificates.same_vector_word_distinct_histories: G5 W0_RED/W0_BLUE share vector word but carry distinct internal-state lineage identities
